business_profile.business_overview: Laser Dental BD is a premium dental clinic in Banani & Uttara, Dhaka, specializing in laser dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, Invisalign, dental implants, teeth whitening, and digital smile design. Their mobile-first site uses 'Tap to Call' CTAs. They offer high-value cosmetic procedures and maintain a gallery, blog, and patient-education videos. There is no online appointment booking system.
business_profile.offer_surface: Autonomous AI agent deployment for Premium dental clinic — targeting: Online appointment booking with treatment-specific routing (cosmetic vs general vs orthodontic); Treatment cost estimation for high-value enquiries (Invisalign, implants, veneers); Multi-visit treatment-plan scheduling and reminder automation; Two-branch patient routing and availability management

pricing_knowledge.note: High-value cosmetic procedures. Patients researching Invisalign/implants want price guidance and easy booking. An AI cost-estimator + booking agent captures high-ticket cosmetic enquiries that a tap-to-call-only flow loses.

business_profile.competitive_position: Laser Dental competes with Tech Dental Care and other premium Dhaka clinics. Their edge is cosmetic/laser specialization. But tap-to-call-only intake loses patients to clinics with online booking. An AI cost-estimator + booking agent would win high-ticket cosmetic enquiries.
business_profile.opportunity_size: Cosmetic procedures (Invisalign, implants) are high-ticket. If tap-to-call-only intake and no cost guidance lose even a fraction of cosmetic enquiries — and multi-visit patients aren't followed up automatically — that's substantial lost high-margin revenue. An AI agent recovers this.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI booking agent with treatment-specific routing.
2. Treatment cost estimator for high-value enquiries.
3. Multi-visit treatment-plan scheduling + reminders.
4. Two-branch routing + availability management.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A patient researching Invisalign visits Laser Dental's site at 11pm and wants a price. Instead of only a tap-to-call, the AI replies: 'Invisalign typically ranges ৳X-Y depending on case. I can book a consultation at Banani or Uttara — which is closer?' The patient books Banani for Saturday. Laser Dental captured a high-ticket cosmetic lead overnight.
